_excluded.capabilities.largestSourceFiles: array length is constant by construction
_excluded.capabilities.untestedCallbacks: L8's candidate key: 'shapes a test names' needs a semantic judgement the collector cannot make from syntax alone, so a count here would be a proxy that can be satisfied without guarding anything -- adjudicated per dependency instead
_excluded.debt.coveragePercent: already machine-checked by pytest's fail_under -- no second source
_excluded.debt.ledgerLines: the ledger is append-only session record that §N10 mandates; gating it makes honest bookkeeping illegal -- measured for the ratio check, reviewed, never auto-failed
_excluded.debt.lintFindings: already machine-checked by ruff -- no second source
_excluded.debt.markdownPercentClaims: counts ordinary prose percentages too, so it is too coarse to guard; L5 adjudicates
_excluded.debt.typeErrors: already machine-checked by mypy -- no second source
_excluded.debt.yieldSites: a bare yield count is not a cleanup defect; that class needs the finally block read per site, which a generic probe cannot assert honestly
_excluded.git.filesTouchedSinceLastCommit: always 0 on a clean checkout; can never fire in CI
_excluded.git.head: not a quantity
_excluded.runtime.*: versions legitimately rise on upgrade; guarding them blocks upgrading
_excluded.warnings.contradictions: a composite counter: adding any new probe would trip it with no debt change, so the individual contradiction keys are gated and this total is only reviewed

_floorKeys.debt.testFunctions: tests may only be added, never quietly deleted

_floorPolicy: Floors are set below the committed-truth reading on purpose. debt.testFunctions is counted from files on disk, so it differs between environments: a working tree holding another session's uncommitted tests reads higher than the checkout CI builds. Seeding a floor at the exact local number therefore guarantees a false red -- this happened twice, once at 423 against CI's 419 and again at 426 against 424, both from re-running --seed locally. The floor's job is to catch mass deletion of tests, not to equal the count.

_keys.capabilities.artifactCopyWithoutMember: vendored copies whose source is gone
_keys.capabilities.entrypointsWithoutTarget: console scripts whose module cannot resolve
_keys.capabilities.memberWithoutArtifactCopy: source packages shipped by no installed wheel
_keys.capabilities.navDanglingEntries: nav entries naming a file that is absent
_keys.capabilities.navOrphanPages: docs pages referenced by no nav entry
_keys.capabilities.packagesWithoutManifest: package dirs that are not workspace members
_keys.debt.auditApparatusLines: prompt/spec documents an audit series keeps rewriting
_keys.debt.suppressionDirectives: lint and type suppressions in shipped code
_keys.debt.swallowedExceptionSites: except blocks that can hide a failure from status
_keys.debt.todoMarkers: debt comments left in shipped code
_keys.debt.unwiredCheckers: checker scripts that no workflow invokes

_seedNote: Seeded from a clean reading: ceilings were re-seeded after the collector stopped counting gitignored test output. packagesWithoutManifest was 1 while packages/artifacts/ (a gitignored directory the suite itself writes, with hundreds of generated notebooks) looked like a package without a manifest -- so any local pytest run turned the ratchet red for a reason unrelated to debt. It now requires Python source, and is seeded at 0. warnings.contradictions was dropped as a ceiling: it is a composite counter, so adding a probe would trip CI with no debt change; the individual contradiction keys are gated instead. Floors are pinned to a pristine `git archive` export of HEAD (testFunctions 420), never to the working tree, because a floor above what CI can check out is a guaranteed false red. Option A earlier decoupled AUDIT_LEDGER.md volume from debt.auditApparatusLines.
